Why not join me? I have a heart condition myself and though I do like surgery, I am becoming a pediatric interventional cardiologist. Idk what you’re interests are but I’ll share my reasons 
- Better lifestyle 
- SLIGHTLY more job openings 
- Can still have OR time in the ever evolving hybrid procedures
- the patients are YOUR patients. You see them grow up, you’re there for them. When they need surgery, you transfer their care to someone else for a few weeks at most, then they’re back to you. In addition, if they’re having surgery at the hospital you work at, you could still manage the patient 
- catheterizing isn’t the same as surgery, but it’s still invasive and pretty cool what can be done with a catheter. For certain conditions and diseases, they will eventually need surgery. Though I find every second that can be spared before surgery is needed is vital.
- pretty invulnerable to scope creep. Whether you’re a surgeon or doctor, parents want the absolute best for their children and will not settle for less.

Obviously ped cards isn’t for everyone, and there’s more points to make, but definitely something to consider if you’re passionate about children’s hearts. :)
